rites.name: Ryanimwen
rites.text: Ryanimwen is a concept of Seresum, the sounding that lets the first roots of the world take shape, and it is the force by which early groves learn to hold their ground. It is felt as a hum running under the soil, shaping seed and stone alike as the first sovereign's kingdoms begin to grow.

rites.name: Lesanum
rites.text: A volatile glowing orb that is hurled in threes by a caster, then vanishes and reappears elsewhere to hurl more. It drifts steadily in a straight line, passes through solid walls, and is easily shattered by any blow.

rites.name: Telisiastor
rites.text: A guardian sheltered in the grove shields all who stand nearby with a canopy of leaves. Foes drawn into the canopy suffer a slow withering that grows fiercer as the land is conquered.

rites.name: Sisallor
rites.text: A temporary frenzy that a wearer gains when a complete set of their guardian gear is worn. Whenever the bearer is wounded, their siege engines fire twice as swiftly for a brief spell.

rites.name: Teliniastes
rites.text: A hidden measure that tilts the outcome of chance-driven happenings in the realm. It can be raised or lowered through potions and by where lanterns are set, and a sage can gauge it for a seeker.

rites.name: Vaulliantia
rites.text: A lingering affliction that stops a bearer from mending and slowly drains their life each second. A certain charm worn by the bearer can ward it off completely.

rites.name: Seriresia
rites.text: A sluggish curse that halves a wanderer's sideways pace after touch from certain spirits or beams. Specific talismans and shields grant immunity to it.

rites.name: Sostanum
rites.text: A blessing that quietly sharpens a person's fortune while it lasts. The longer the blessing holds, the stronger the fortune it grants.

rites.name: Neorelles
rites.text: A hex that strikes only the bearer during a dust storm, slowly dragging them along the gale's path and hampering their stride. Foes behave as though they carry it too, yet walls and tethered hooks resist its pull.

rites.name: Casium
rites.text: A cursed hex unleashed by a colossal sinew-wall that snares anyone who lingers near it or tries to flee its domain. The snared victim is yanked forward by a fleshy tendril and battered severely.

rites.name: Restia
rites.text: A sinking-and-slowing condition that takes hold of a wanderer dipped into a thick liquid. Without a special charm the wanderer settles to the floor, and breath slowly fails while submerged.

rites.name: Carnus
rites.text: A harsher form of burning that stops wounds from closing and drains the afflicted's life over time. Emits flickering sparks and faint glow, and is extinguished by plunging into any liquid save molten rock.

rites.name: Vania
rites.text: A grim enchanted tablet of rune-plates that a travelling sorcerer sells only when the crimson night sky appears. Its bearer wields it as a weapon of hard-won arcane power.

rites.name: Coraulernum
rites.text: Wayfarers bind a summoned beast or vessel to their body, letting them ride it freely. Only one such ride may be active at once, and it ends when the rider falls.

rites.name: Riallanum
rites.text: A small, glowing orb of liquid that is launched in quick bursts by hidden casters. It drifts straight ahead through solid walls and dissolves when struck by any weapon.

rites.name: Resium
rites.text: A set of temporary blessings that a traveler receives after eating a meal. Their strength and length depend on the dish, and only one blessing can rest upon a person at a time, with the newest one replacing the old.

rites.name: Telarnia
rites.text: A sticky binding that locks a wanderer fully in place, halting every motion at once. It is spat by lurking crawlers, and only restorative draughts can still be used while held.

rites.name: Kurnaithoth
rites.text: Kurnaithoth is the concept of the Weave as it is planted during the Seeding, a quiet thread of power that the makers lay across Seresum before it wakes. In the Age of the first sovereign it is understood as the patient pull that shapes groves and growing kingdoms.

rites.name: Lestialor
rites.text: A stony curse that turns a wanderer rigid and immobile, making falls far more punishing. It strips away protections against falling and can be warded off by certain charms or potions.

rites.name: Terus
rites.text: A lingering enfeeblement that dulls a bearer's guard, blows, and pace. It can be warded off by wearing a sustaining charm or one of its lesser forms.

rites.name: Orauses
rites.text: A sticky azure affliction that clings to any creature it touches, leaking blue droplets. While it lingers, it doubles the lingering burn of fire-based afflictions.

rites.name: Lentosia
rites.text: A muddling curse that flips a bearer's sideways steering so every step goes the opposite way. Afflicted foes drift away from their quarry and lose their ranged reach, while a folded charted parchment shields against it.

rites.name: Valernolum
rites.text: Mid-air leaps granted by carried trinkets or rides can be chained, but leaps of the same kind do not add together. Each kind shows its own glimmer, and the glimmers always appear in a fixed sequence.

rites.name: Viarnonia
rites.text: A lingering affliction that stops a bearer's body from mending itself, so wounds stay open and quietly drain life. Restorative draughts and ordinary provisions still work, while a binding wrap or a regenerating charm can ward it off or undo it.

rites.name: Amestus Rialles
rites.text: A bodily restoration that quietens after a wound and slowly returns strength to a wanderer. Its pace rises when the wanderer stays still, rests upon a soft seat, or waits longer after the last blow.

rites.name: Telores
rites.text: A cold affliction that stops a victim from healing and slowly drains their life each second. Anything coated in a special slick takes far harsher harm from it.

rites.name: Cilium
rites.text: A bone-carved headpiece that calls forth spectral hands from the shadows. The hands lunge toward foes, slipping through solid stone and striking up to three enemies.

rites.name: Saustum
rites.text: A dimming trance that seizes a wanderer who touches the luminous tide, dragging them downward through solid stone until a hollow pocket is found. Those caught in it cannot step sideways or act, though only the strikes of great beasts can harm them.

rites.name: Amiallus
rites.text: A glittering affliction that marks foes with a golden shine. Those touched by it spill far more coin when they fall, rewarding whoever brings them down.

rites.name: Lernum
rites.text: A fleeting power that a fighter gains by timing a raised guard just as an incoming blow lands. For a few heartbeats afterward, any strike with a blade or club hits with several times its normal force.

rites.name: Tillasum
rites.text: Small marked tokens spoken aloud before a journey begins. They alter how the traveler's world behaves from the moment the road is entered.

rites.name: Rorium Cestes
rites.text: A hidden seed of the world that transforms the open surface and sky layers into a radiant realm, while leaving the corrupted biomes untouched.

rites.name: Tiria Serirnanum
rites.text: A fuel that a wielder spends when channeling enchanted arms, shown as a column of blue sparks at the screen's edge. It refills on its own when the wielder pauses, and fuller reserves refill faster.

rites.name: Sallanum
rites.text: A brief shelter that wraps a being right after a blow, so it cannot be harmed again. This keeps relentless hazards from wearing it down many times in a single moment.

rites.name: Sereornus
rites.text: A bloodthirsty craft by which a fighter mends their own wounds with a share of the harm they inflict. A cursed mark can seal this renewal shut, and certain blades and cloaks grant the gift.

rites.name: Nallor Riallanum
rites.text: A practiced craft that moves a traveler instantly to a chosen spot without crossing the distance between. Users typically leap to a prepared refuge, a fixed home point, or a marked network of waypoints.

rites.name: Coreollum
rites.text: These summoning implements call forth unbreakable helpers that roam beside the wielder and strike foes nearby. A related lash brings the helpers' attention to whatever it strikes.

rites.name: Nileonium
rites.text: A dampening affliction that blocks a bearer from channeling spellcraft or calling forth summoned arms, though previously called allies endure. Certain ward-tokens, voice-amplifiers and sigil-charms purge the hex the moment they are worn.

rites.name: Veontor Valernia
rites.text: A slick coating clings to a foe struck by a hidden snare, making it suffer heavier ongoing harm from flames, curses, chill, and shadow. The effect varies in strength depending on which of those afflictions is already burning it.

rites.name: Valistor
rites.text: A temporary surge of arcane vigor that strengthens a bearer's spellcraft. Its strength wanes as the surge fades, and it shows as bluish motes drifting around the bearer.

rites.name: Coraunus
rites.text: A timed counter that cancels an incoming blow entirely and strikes back at the attacker. The defender then gains a brief surge of strength for the next close-quarters strike.

rites.name: Valeosium
rites.text: A crackling storm-shroud that wraps around a creature or wanderer, sparking with light but never harming. It comes in two shades, one cool and one fiery.

rites.name: Corauria Mornium
rites.text: A foul-smelling curse that dims a wanderer's fortune and sends onlookers scattering from them. The afflicted take on a sickly greenish hue and exhale a faint verdant haze. Immersion in any fluid except molten stone lifts the curse, while a soaked state shields creatures from it, though not the wanderers themselves.

rites.name: Isyuthazora
rites.text: Isyuthazora is the concept of a binding grove-thread that the first sovereign of Seresum wove between the walls of the Walled Age, a force that holds stone to its promise. Its power is measured in the vows it keeps, and it is said to hold the walled orders together through centuries of rising churches and first crossings.

rites.name: Nillia Corasorium
rites.text: Beneficial enchantments that a bearer receives upon consuming or wielding certain relics, displayed as glowing marks beneath their hand. They fade after a time and are lost when the bearer falls.

rites.name: Vauntiares
rites.text: A wild affliction that spreads when a creature bites a traveler, sharpening the victim's strikes while slowing their natural mending. It also brings sudden fits of gloom, hexes, confusion, and weakness.

rites.name: Serontum
rites.text: A lingering burn that clings to foes after a searing strike, dealing steady harm for a few heartbeats. Repeated strikes pile the burn higher, multiplying the harm each stack brings.

rites.name: Saullium
rites.text: A random, rare strike that lands with extra force, doubling a blow's harm and sending the target reeling farther. Its marks show bolder, deeper-hued figures that hang in view longer than ordinary wounds.

rites.name: Seontes Meontania
rites.text: A bearer may glide freely through the open air for a limited span. The gift can come from strapped jet-boots, feathered harness, or a bonded steed, and a special sigil lets it last without end.

rites.name: Risteorium
rites.text: A mechanism that lets a wielder fix their aim onto a chosen foe, so that targets are struck automatically. It works on foes, great beasts, and small creatures alike.

rites.name: Mauses Nialium
rites.text: A shimmering powder that transforms the wearer into a tiny winged being, granting endless flight, a faint glow, and the ability to slip through narrow gaps. Using other tools breaks the spell and returns the user to their usual shape.

rites.name: Telistiaria
rites.text: A bearer slips past harm entirely, so the blow, its push, and any lingering affliction vanish. Brief shielding follows, extended by a charm worn at the throat.

rites.name: Amaulium Laurneontor
rites.text: A quick burst of forward momentum that a wielder can trigger to cover a short stretch of ground instantly. It helps slow riding beasts reach high speed and lets fighters slip past incoming blows.

rites.name: Taulor Saullium
rites.text: A hidden seed that makes the sky pour rain for an extended span of time. While it lasts, the weather controls cannot ease the downpour below a fixed minimum.

rites.name: Valiasus
rites.text: A practice in which a wielder slips into near-invisibility after a brief pause, so certain foes cannot lock onto them, while gaining sharper strikes. It cannot be taken while riding a beast.

rites.name: Amaunirnor
rites.text: Amaunirnor is a crowned tide-titan of Seresum's drowned lowlands, a mass of living jelly that rises only when someone bears the sigil of its sunken throne or when the ocean chooses to stir it. Each wound it suffers tears off a bright, hungry shard that scatters across the marsh as a lesser brood of its own kind.

rites.name: Amarnium
rites.text: Amarnium is a mythic concept of an eye-bearing sovereign that drifts through the dim reaches of Seresum after nightfall, its gaze pulling loose the fears of everything beneath it. Its moods shift between languid hovering and sudden, furious lunges, and at its call hollow watchers spill from the dark to serve its unseen design.

rites.name: Varus
rites.text: Varus is a sacred burrowing serpent of the Seresum deep-chapels, said to sleep beneath the roots of the oldest lanterns until a vessel of hollowed glass is broken above it. When wounded it sheds its body into a clutch of coiling kin, each segment hunting with its own will until they reunite at dusk.

rites.name: Tonanum
rites.text: Tonanum is a drifting, pulsing mind-engine of the Seresum mythic age, a vast membrane that tends a ring of tethered sentinel-lights which must be extinguished before the core can be reached. Its presence is summoned when a sacred ribbed spire in the outer dust is struck in the proper rhythm.

rites.name: Telialus
rites.text: Telialus is the drowsy sovereign of the Hollow Comb, a vast hymn-humming sentience that nests within the honeyed sinews of the Verdant Deep of Seresum. It rouses only when its brood is threatened, sending forth its winged retinue and a barbed lance of crystallised pollen.

rites.name: Valus
rites.text: Valus is a vast floating skull of dark bone, sustained by two enormous spectral hands that drift beside it like sentinels. Within the Seresum mythic age it is said to wear a mild old man's face by daylight and shed it only under the night's cold, when its true form descends to bar the way to the sunless vaults below.

rites.name: Serontia
rites.text: Serontia is a pale, sprawling sea-monster of the deep rifts of Seresum, a stone-skinned titan that dwells in the molten underlayer of the world. It answers to no name but its own, and when its vast bulk rises through the magma it wakes the ancient law that binds the realm to harder trials.

rites.name: Losernium
rites.text: Losernium is a mythic concept of a crowned, winged slime that rules over an endless tide of lesser crowned slimes in the hallowed reaches of Seresum. Its legend holds that each loyal slime it summons carries a fragment of its dominion, letting its court rise from any shimmering crystal the world offers.

rites.name: Lisonia
rites.text: Lisonia is a sealed lattice of tuned glass that hums only while its twin wardens keep watch over the dark half of Seresum's orbit. When the twin lenses of a sleeping sky-kiln wake together, Lisonia flares into a single unbroken sun that scorches whole mountain ranges. She can only be quieted when both of her halves are cracked in the same heartbeat.

rites.name: Mianum
rites.text: Mianum is a concept of living-metal wardens in the Seresum mythic era, sealed in the sixth age to guard the boundary between tides of starlight. Its segments can hold a star's worth of stored light, which it discharges in a single ruinous lance.

rites.name: Amirnium
rites.text: A late-stage hex that severs a bearer's ability to draw life back from their strikes for as long as it lingers. It is laid only by a colossal celestial overlord's assault.
